caption: The drawing depicts a wooden jointed doll set against a plain, off-white background. The doll is shown standing upright, facing forward, with articulated joints visible at the shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees. The head is round with painted features including black hair, arched eyebrows, small eyes, a straight nose, and red lips with pink cheeks. The upper torso is drawn in a light brown shade, resembling carved or painted wood, with lighter areas indicating highlights. The arms and legs are also brown, but the forearms and lower legs are colored in a lighter, almost white hue, and the feet are tipped in dark brown or black. The joints are depicted using slightly darker lines, emphasizing their construction. There are no additional objects or background elements in the image. The artist's name, “Clinton G. Mixe,” is handwritten in small letters near the bottom right corner of the paper.
title: Doll
